core_obligations: Show the underlying map on spectra is a homeomorphism: closedness from integrality, density of the image, and surjectivity together (proof lines 11000-11010).
Show the residue field extensions are isomorphisms by the 2-3 argument on the generators, and check that the two hypotheses survive base change (proof lines 11010-11027).
proof_roadmap: Assemble homeomorphism from closedness, density and surjectivity (proof lines 10999-11010).
Settle the residue field and base change parts (proof lines 11010-11028).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a ring map generated by elements whose square and cube lie in the image of the base, with locally nilpotent kernel, induces isomorphisms on residue fields and a homeomorphism on spectra, and that these hypotheses are stable under base change (statement lines 10986-10997). The proof does not use the 2-3 trick in the abstract: it obtains closedness from integrality, density of the image, and surjectivity, then analyses the residue field extensions through the generators, and verifies stability under base change (proof lines 10999-11028). Combining closedness with density to get a homeomorphism is the step the argument turns on. H2.
